import {mkdtempSync as makeTempSync} from 'node:fs'
import * as fsPromises from 'node:fs/promises'
import {mkdtemp as makeTemp} from 'fs/promises'
import * as nodeOs from 'node:os'
import {tmpdir as osTemp} from 'os'
import {join} from 'node:path'

export async function makeFolders(): Promise<string[]> {
  return [
    makeTempSync(join(osTemp(), 'x-')),
    await makeTemp(join(nodeOs.tmpdir(), 'x-')),
    await fsPromises.mkdtemp(join(osTemp(), 'x-')),
  ]
}
